principles.statement: Reuse an existing organizational service before adding a new delivery path
principles.rationale: Every delivery path must be secured and monitored
principles.implications: A new channel needs an ADR that explains why the existing one cannot serve

modules.name: Authentication
modules.security_boundary: Public entry point; account data is private to its holder

modules.name: Notifications
modules.purpose: Outbound email through the existing notification service
modules.security_boundary: Internal; called only by other modules

decisions.title: Send reset emails through the existing notification service
decisions.context: FR-AUTH-001 requires an email. The organization already operates a notification service with delivery logging.
decisions.decision: Password-reset emails are sent by calling the existing notification service. No new mail integration is added.
decisions.rationale: One delivery path keeps sending, logging and monitoring in one place (PRIN-001), and the owner chose it in DEC-002.

alternatives.description: Send mail from the authentication module
alternatives.disadvantages: Second delivery path to secure and monitor

positive: Delivery failures are visible in the notification service's existing log.
negative: The reset request depends on the notification service being reachable.

risks: RISK-001 — the notification service is unavailable and reset emails are delayed.
constraints: Reset emails are sent only through MOD-002; no module sends email directly.
A new delivery channel for account emails requires a new ADR.

decisions.title: Store only a hash of each reset token
decisions.context: SR-001 forbids storing reset tokens in a recoverable form.
decisions.decision: The token store keeps a one-way hash of each token, its account, its issue time and its used flag. The token itself exists only in the email.
decisions.rationale: A leaked token store must not let anyone reset a password (SR-001); only a one-way hash guarantees that.

alternatives.description: Store a hash of the token
alternatives.advantages: A leaked store yields no usable token

alternatives.disadvantages: A leaked key exposes every live token

positive: A leaked token store yields no usable token.
negative: A lost email means requesting a new link; the old one cannot be re-sent.

constraints: No reset token is stored in a recoverable form, encrypted or plain.
A reset link cannot be re-sent; a new request issues a new token.
